subdimensions.name: Affective Resonance
subdimensions.justification: Interactions are coercive: six people were reportedly killed by police at a facility civil society calls unlawful and inhumane.

Civil society organizations condemned the excessive and disproportionate use of lethal force, and described the facility as an unlawful and inhumane detention facility.

subdimensions.name: Perspective-Taking
